theater: 鎮江焦山水城及兩岸江面

battle.name: 焦山之戰
battle.theater: 鎮江焦山水城及兩岸江面
battle.brief: 德祐元年七月，元軍阿朮在瓜洲、西津渡集船，分兵扼殊金沙以控上游。宋將張世傑以萬餘艘、十船一舫、鐵索相連的水軍橫列焦山南北江面沉碇死守。初二日元軍小艇橫衝，兩翼弩箭與火箭齊發，宋船被焚；半日後宋軍大潰，元軍追至焦山，俘船七百餘艘。弩手困在難以轉向的宋艦甲板，裝填遲緩而失去節奏。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 焦山之戰是南宋德祐元年、元朝至元十二年（一二七五年）七月，在長江下游鎮江府東面的焦山水城一帶，元軍水師與南宋水軍的一場決戰。交戰一方是元朝為攻滅南宋而組成的江淮大軍：荊湖行省平章政事阿朮統率前線水師，右丞相阿塔海、參知政事董文炳分任中樞與一翼，萬戶張弘範、劉國傑、忽剌、劉琛、懷都各領本部；戰船自瓜洲江岸與南岸西津渡集結，江北據點與沿江渡口由元軍掌握，兵員、戰船與攻城器械自北方向南輸送。另一方是南宋臨安朝廷的江防體系：主戰將領張世傑以保康軍承宣使、總都督府諸軍之號率水陸兵北上，收復常州、廣德軍後節節退守金山與焦山一線；平江都統劉師勇、知泰州孫虎臣率水軍隨張世傑作戰，殿前都指揮使張彥奉命自常州率兵趨京口，揚州李庭芝出兵瓜洲，淮南與兩浙的制置司、沿海水寨、江上水軍都歸這套指揮體系調度。兩軍在長江中段狹窄的江面上對峙，一方要保臨安門戶，一方要打通直抵臨安的水道。
countriesEn: The Battle of Jiao Mountain was a decisive engagement fought in the seventh month of the first year of the Dedu era of the Southern Song, the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan era of the Yuan (1275), at the water fortress of Jiao Mountain east of Zhenjiang prefecture on the middle and lower Yangtze. One side was the Yangtze and Huai army assembled by the Yuan for the destruction of the Southern Song: the pacification commissioner of the Jinghu branch secretariat, Aju, commanded the forward river force, the right chancellor Ataqai and the vice chancellor Dong Wenbing held the centre and one flank respectively, and the commandery commanders Zhang Hongfan, Liu Guojie, Hula, Liu Chen and Huaidu each led their own contingents. Their warships were assembled at the riverbank of Guazhou and at Xijin ferry on the south bank, the Yuan held the northern posts and the crossings along the river, and troops, hulls and siege engines were brought southward from the north. The other side was the river-defence structure of the Southern Song court at Lin'an: the leading general Zhang Shijie was appointed commissioner of the Baokang army and commander of the armies of the Supreme Commander's Office, and led land and water forces northward; after retaking Changzhou and Guangde prefecture he fell back step by step to the line of Jinshan and Jiao Mountain. Liu Shiyong, military commander of Pingjiang, and Sun Huchen, magistrate of Taizhou, led the river force alongside him; the commander of the Palace Guard, Zhang Yan, was ordered to march from Changzhou towards Jingkou, and Li Tingzhi of Yangzhou moved out from Guazhou. The military control commissions of Huainan and Liangzhe, the coastal stockades and the fleets on the river were all drawn into this command structure. The two armies confronted each other in the narrow stretch of the Yangtze, one to hold the door of Lin'an, the other to open a water route straight to it.
people: 張世傑是南宋此戰的主帥。他以保康軍承宣使、總都督府諸軍率兵北上，收復常州與廣德軍後仍欲反攻，兵敗退至金山，遂與殿前都指揮使張彥、揚州李庭芝相約三路合擊元軍：自己當金山一路，張彥自常州趨京口，李庭芝出瓜洲，三面夾擊。張彥與李庭芝未能按期抵達，張世傑便與平江都統劉師勇、知泰州孫虎臣率水軍獨自迎戰，決定以十舟一舫、鐵索相連把陣線釘在焦山江面。元軍主帥阿朮是此役的關鍵人物：他先登南岸石公山觀察，見宋軍旌旗蔽江、船艦以鐵索相連，當即判定火攻配合兩翼夾擊可以破敵陣，隨後居中調度，選強健射手一千人在大船兩翼夾射。參知政事董文炳率水師自焦山南麓攻宋軍右翼，萬戶劉國傑攻左翼，萬戶忽剌出其中路，萬戶劉琛沿南岸東取夾灘、迂迴到宋軍背後切斷退路，萬戶張弘範率千人溯江西上攻殊金沙控制上游，待令順風而下從焦山北麓攻入，萬戶懷都則率步騎在江岸布陣封住登岸之路。張弘範其後於一二七九年崖山海役統率元軍水師，值得留意的是，焦山一役正是他在火攻配合與水陸協同上磨出來的樣板。
peopleEn: Zhang Shijie was the commander on the Song side of this battle. Appointed commissioner of the Baokang army and commander of the armies of the Supreme Commander's Office, he led troops north, retaking Changzhou and Guangde prefecture, and was still seeking to counterattack when he was beaten and fell back to Jinshan. There he agreed with the commander of the Palace Guard, Zhang Yan, and with Li Tingzhi of Yangzhou on a three-pronged pincer against the Yuan: he himself taking the Jinshan route, Zhang Yan moving from Changzhou towards Jingkou, and Li Tingzhi advancing out of Guazhou, so that the Yuan would be caught from three sides. Neither Zhang Yan nor Li Tingzhi arrived on time, so Zhang Shijie, with Liu Shiyong, military commander of Pingjiang, and Sun Huchen, magistrate of Taizhou, met the Yuan alone with the river force and resolved to pin his line to the river at Jiao Mountain, ten ships to a raft chained together with iron cables. Aju was the decisive figure on the Yuan side. He first climbed the heights of Shigong hill on the south bank to look over the field, saw the Song banners covering the river and the ships joined by iron chains, and judged at once that fire attack combined with a pincer from both wings would break the Song array; he then took the centre of the command, choosing a thousand strong archers to shoot from the wings of his largest vessels. The vice chancellor Dong Wenbing led the water force from the southern foot of Jiao Mountain against the Song right wing, the commandery commander Liu Guojie struck the left wing, Hula came out through the middle, Liu Chen moved east along the south bank to seize Jietan and turned behind the Song line to cut their retreat, Zhang Hongfan took a thousand men upstream to attack Shujinsha and hold the upper river, waiting for the wind to carry him down onto the northern foot of Jiao Mountain, and Huaidu deployed infantry and cavalry along the bank to seal off any landing. Zhang Hongfan later commanded the Yuan fleet at the Battle of Yamen in 1279, and it is worth noting that the fire attack and the coordination of water and land he showed at Jiao Mountain were the pattern he carried forward from here.
kits: 十字弩在此戰中的位置，是宋軍每艘大船甲板上的固定射位，也是元軍兩翼火力壓制的骨幹。宋軍以十舟為一舫、鐵索相連，舫上除水手、槳手與火攻器材之外，弩手沿舷列陣，以弩箭居高射擊來犯小艇；弩的穿透力強、單發精度高，在穩定的甲板上本可有效阻止小艇靠近，但裝填緩慢，一旦射位被火箭引燃，整舫火力便同時癱瘓。元軍則把小型戰船列在前段，這些快船吃水淺、轉向靈活，以硬弓與手弩近射配合火箭施放；阿朮所選的一千名強健射手分乘大船居兩翼，弩箭與弓矢夾射，專打宋艦甲板上的弩位與火油器材，切斷宋軍的還擊節奏。火攻是此役的勝負手：宋軍連鎖大船體量龐大、難以變向，一旦被火矢點燃便難以隔離，燃燒順著鐵索與艙板蔓延；元軍岸上另有懷都所部的步騎，並備有配重投石車一類攻城器械，用於突破城垣與水寨，而不是在江面縱火。運輸方面，元軍戰船與糧秣自北沿運河與陸路南下，江北據點提供船材與船工；宋軍水軍全賴長江航運，糧食由平江、常州、揚州方向後送，卻因北面失守而失去主要產糧區與船塢，補充速度遠不及消耗。馬匹主要在元軍岸上步騎手中，由於戰場完全在水中，騎兵無法直接參與，只能封岸與掩護屯集。
kitsEn: The crossbow's place in this battle was as the fixed firing position on the deck of every large Song ship, and as the backbone of the Yuan's suppressive fire from the two wings. The Song formation was ten ships to a raft chained with iron cables; besides boatmen, oarsmen and fire-attack equipment, crossbowmen stood in line along the gunwales and shot down at the incoming small craft. The crossbow had real penetration and accuracy, and on a stable deck it could have kept the small boats at a distance, but it loads slowly, and once a firing position was lit by a fire arrow the whole raft's output went down together. The Yuan instead put their small warships in the van: shallow-draft, quick to turn, combining bows and hand crossbows at close range with fire arrows. The thousand strong archers Aju picked out were embarked on his largest vessels in the two wings, shooting bolts and arrows in a crossfire aimed precisely at the crossbow positions and the oil jars on the Song decks, to break the rhythm of the Song return fire. Fire was the decisive arm of the engagement: the chained Song ships were bulky and could not turn, and once lit they could not be separated, the burning running along the iron cables and along the planking. On the shore the Yuan also had the infantry and cavalry of Huaidu, and they brought counterweight trebuchets of the kind used to batter walls and river stockades, not to set fires on the river. On the logistics side, the Yuan drew their warships and provisions down from the north along the canal and by road, with the northern posts supplying timber and shipwrights. The Song fleet depended entirely on Yangtze transport, with grain pushed up from Pingjiang, Changzhou and Yangzhou; but with the north lost they had also lost the main grain districts and the shipyards, and replacements could not keep pace with expenditure. Horses sat with the Yuan cavalry on the banks; with the fighting entirely on the water, the horsemen could not take part directly and could only seal the shore and cover the assembly of the troops.
tactics: 宋軍取的是鎖江之陣：以十舟為一舫，鐵索相連，於江面沉碇，橫列焦山南北兩段江面，旌旗蔽江，並明令非有號令不得起碇，意圖以不動之陣封住航道，逼元軍來攻，再以集中的弩矢與火矢反覆消耗來犯之敵。問題在於鎖江之陣必須整體移動、整體反應：一旦某舷被點火，鐵索會把火勢與騷亂傳給相鄰的舫，前排船隻還會堵塞後排的射界。元軍的解法是把三條線疊在一起：一是火攻，阿朮在石公山觀陣之後定策，用火箭配以火油燒擊宋艦；二是兩翼夾射，一千名強健射手分乘大船左右，弩箭、弓矢壓制宋軍甲板射位；三是水陸並進，萬戶劉琛沿南岸取夾灘迂迴到宋軍之後，張弘範自上游順風疾下，懷都的步騎在江岸封死登岸與撤退的方向，元軍的小型戰船則直衝宋軍大船的側舷，用撞角與火矢破開鎖鏈。船隊接觸之後，交鋒在半日之內即分出勝負。
tacticsEn: The Song chose a chained river line: ten ships to a raft, joined by iron cables, anchored where it lay in the river and drawn up north and south of Jiao Mountain, banners covering the river, with the standing order that no ship might weigh anchor without the command signal. The intention was to seal the channel with an array that would not move, force the Yuan to come on, and wear them down with concentrated bolts and fire arrows. The weakness of the chained line is that it must move and react as a single body: once one side of a raft is alight, the cables carry the fire and the confusion to the neighbouring rafts, and the ships in front block the firing arcs of those behind. The Yuan answered by stacking three lines of effort. First, fire attack: after observing from Shigong hill, Aju settled on the plan and burned the Song hulls with fire arrows and oil. Second, crossfire from both wings: a thousand strong archers were embarked in large vessels on the left and the right, their bolts and arrows suppressing the firing positions on the Song decks. Third, water and land advancing together: the commandery commander Liu Chen moved east along the south bank to Jietan and worked round behind the Song line, Zhang Hongfan came down with the wind from the upper river, the infantry and cavalry of Huaidu sealed the bank against any landing or retreat, and the Yuan light warships charged straight at the flanks of the great Song hulls, breaking the chain with ram and fire arrow. Once the fleets closed, the issue was settled inside half a day.
data: 此役可核對的數字如下：時間為德祐元年、至元十二年（一二七五年）七月，具體交戰日是七月初一布陣、次日七月初二接戰；宋軍水軍自稱萬餘艘，編制是十舟為一舫，即以百餘舫計；元軍方面，張弘範所部為千人，駕船溯江西上攻殊金沙；阿朮自大船中選出強健射手一千人，分置兩翼夾射；戰後元軍追至焦山，俘獲黃鵠、白鷞等船七百艘。戰場距離可以由地名推得：焦山在鎮江府城東，橫臥長江之中，金山在西稍北，石公山在東北，夾灘在焦山東北，殊金沙在鎮江西北，瓜洲在東南江岸，西津渡在南岸，焦山與瓜洲之間的江面寬不過數里，正是大船無法展開、小船可以穿插的地形。戰前形勢是：同年二月丁家洲水戰之後，元軍已取建康府、鎮江府、常州等地，張世傑一度收復常州與廣德軍，其後再敗。戰至半日，宋軍大亂，前軍多墜水溺死，後軍逃散。史書未載雙方確切傷亡數與戰船全數，焦山一役的記載集中於部署與經過，人數多以號稱、約數帶過，引用時不宜當作實數。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked for this engagement are these. The date is the seventh month of the first year of Dedu, the twelfth year of Zhiyuan (1275), with the Song array laid out on the first of the month and the fighting joined on the second. The Song fleet claimed more than ten thousand vessels, organised ten ships to a raft, that is on the order of a hundred and more rafts. On the Yuan side, the force under Zhang Hongfan numbered a thousand men, taken by boat up the river to attack Shujinsha, and Aju chose a thousand strong archers out of his largest ships to shoot in a crossfire from the two wings. After the fight the Yuan pursued as far as Jiao Mountain and captured seven hundred vessels, among them the Huanghu and the Baiyao. The distances on the field can be read off from the place names: Jiao Mountain lies east of the city of Zhenjiang prefecture, standing in the Yangtze itself; Jinshan is to the west and a little north, Shigong hill to the north-east, Jietan to the north-east of Jiao Mountain, Shujinsha to the north-west of Zhenjiang, Guazhou on the south-eastern shore, Xijin ferry on the south bank. The stretch of water between Jiao Mountain and Guazhou is no more than a few li across, which is precisely the ground where great ships cannot deploy and small craft can slip through. The situation before the battle: after the naval engagement at Dingjia Zhou in the second month of the same year, the Yuan had taken Jiankang prefecture, Zhenjiang prefecture and Changzhou; Zhang Shijie had retaken Changzhou and Guangde prefecture for a time, and was beaten again afterwards. Fighting went on for half a day, the Song array broke up, the vanguard largely drowned and the rear broke and ran. The histories record no exact casualty figures and no complete count of the fleets; the account of Jiao Mountain concentrates on deployment and course of the fighting, and the numbers of men are given as claims and approximations that should not be treated as exact.
cause: 打起這場戰役的直接原因，是元軍要打通長江中段、拿下臨安。忽必烈自一二七四年起命伯顏率軍南下，襄樊、鄂州、江陵、潭州一路攻拔，元軍已據江漢、控江淮；一二七五年二月丁家洲水戰，宋軍水師覆沒，戰局急轉，二月之後元軍連取建康府、鎮江府、常州，長江下游門戶洞開，臨安只剩下焦山至金山一線的江防。宋廷起用主戰派張世傑，收復常州、廣德軍，本是要把元軍擋在建康之外，但再攻失利之後，退路與糧道同時縮短，宋廷改為死守：命張世傑以總都督府諸軍節制江上兵力，張彥自常州策應，李庭芝出瓜洲，張世傑本人率師至金山，意圖以三路合擊在江上殲滅元軍水師，再圖反攻。張世傑提出以鐵索連舟、沉碇橫江的辦法，實為在無城可守的江心以人力造城：既然焦山有水城與兩岸山勢可倚，便把船陣當成城牆，把弩手當成城頭射手，讓元軍必須在不利於其小船行動的江段正面強攻。元軍不容南宋重整江防，阿朮的任務即是摧毀這道水上城牆。
causeEn: The immediate cause of this battle was the Yuan need to open the middle Yangtze and take Lin'an. From 1274 Kublai Khan had sent Bayan south with the army; the captures at Xiangyang, Ezhou, Jiangling and Tanzhou left the Yuan holding the Han and Yangzi and commanding the Jianghuai. After the naval battle of Dingjia Zhou in the second month of 1275 the Song fleet was destroyed and the course of the war turned; in the months after, the Yuan took Jiankang prefecture, Zhenjiang prefecture and Changzhou in succession, the lower Yangtze door stood open, and all that stood between the enemy and Lin'an was the line of river defences from Jiao Mountain to Jinshan. The court brought Zhang Shijie, the leading advocate of fighting, to the head: he was sent north to retake Changzhou and Guangde prefecture, to hold the Yuan back beyond Jiankang, but when the renewed offensive failed the line of retreat and the supply road shortened at the same time, and the court fell back on holding ground. Zhang Shijie was made commander of the armies of the Supreme Commander's Office with authority over all forces on the river, Zhang Yan was to support from Changzhou, Li Tingzhi was to come out of Guazhou, and Zhang Shijie himself took his force to Jinshan, hoping to destroy the Yuan fleet on the river in a three-way convergence and then counterattack. The plan of chaining ships together with iron and sinking their anchors across the river was in effect the building of a city in the middle of a river where no city existed: since Jiao Mountain had its water fortress and the heights on both banks to lean on, the ship array would serve as the wall and the crossbowmen as the wall-top archers, forcing the Yuan to attack head-on in a reach of river where its small boats were at a disadvantage. The Yuan would not allow the Song to rebuild the river defences; Aju's task was to break this wall of water.
impact: 焦山之戰是南宋江防結構性的崩壞點。此役之前，宋廷還有可依托的城池與可以重整的兵員；此役之後，張世傑的江上主力損失殆盡，弩手與火攻器材隨七百餘艘被俘的戰船一同落入元軍之手，元軍則可以沿江而下不再受阻。建康失守、臨安門戶洞開，一二七六年二月臨安陷落，恭帝降元，南宋朝廷由江防轉入流亡，一二七九年崖山海役之後宋室覆亡，此役是這條敗亡曲線的關鍵一環。技術與戰術上的影響更為長久：焦山說明以鐵索連舟造出江上城牆的辦法有兩重弱點，一重是火，二重是鎖——火能由一舷牽動全隊，鎖讓全隊無法各自求生；此後元明之間的江海大戰，屢次重演以火攻破連鎖舟、以小艇衝擊大船的套路，明初平定鄱陽湖之戰時火攻連鎖舟的做法，可上溯到焦山。而就十字弩本身而言，焦山是一次教科書式的示範：弩在城頭與城牆之上可靠，因為有固定的射位與遮蔽；一旦失去城牆，落到不能轉向的船甲板上，它的慢裝填、難轉位便全部暴露，成為最先被火矢覆蓋的弱點。此後元明清的兵器改良，弩的式樣屢變，但弩手必須配屬於有遮蔽的固定陣位這一條教訓，一直留到火器普及之後。
impactEn: The Battle of Jiao Mountain was the structural collapse of the Southern Song's river defence. Before it, the court still had cities to lean on and men who could be put back in the line; after it, Zhang Shijie's main force on the river was spent, the crossbowmen and the fire-attack equipment went to the Yuan along with the seven hundred captured ships, and the Yuan could come down the river without being stopped. Jiankang had fallen, the door to Lin'an was open, Lin'an fell in the second month of 1276 and the emperor surrendered; the court passed from defending the river to exile, and after the Battle of Yamen in 1279 the Song house was extinguished. This battle is the hinge of that collapse. Its lessons in technique and tactics lasted longer still: Jiao Mountain showed that the chained raft wall has two weaknesses, one fire and one chain. Fire can run from a single raft into the whole line, and the chain denies every ship the chance to save itself. In the river and sea battles between Yuan and Ming that followed, the pattern of breaking chained fleets with fire and striking great ships with light craft was repeated many times, and the use of fire against chained ships in the early Ming campaign in Poyang Lake can be traced back to Jiao Mountain. As for the crossbow itself, Jiao Mountain is a textbook demonstration: the crossbow is reliable on a wall or a parapet, because it has a fixed firing position and cover; once it loses the wall and stands on a ship deck that cannot turn, its slow loading and awkward traverse are wholly exposed, and it becomes the first target that fire arrows overwhelm. The crossbow was repeatedly redesigned through the Yuan, Ming and Qing, but the rule that crossbowmen must be posted in a covered, fixed position held good long after firearms had spread.
result: 七月初一宋軍列陣橫江，初二開戰。自晨至午後，元軍的火攻與兩翼弩箭同時壓上，宋軍大船被燒、鎖陣被破，前軍多墜水溺死，後軍逃散；張世傑、劉師勇、孫虎臣收攏殘部退走，元軍追至焦山，俘獲黃鵠、白鷞等船七百餘艘，張世傑預定的三路合擊計畫因張彥與李庭芝未至而徹底落空，焦山的水城與江面控制權歸於元軍。對元軍而言，此役是一次以火攻破解連鎖舟陣的完整示範：火矢、弩箭、小艇衝撞與岸上步騎封鎖四種手段同時奏效，且在半天之內結束戰鬥，未容宋軍重整。對南宋而言，江防最後一道可用的水上屏障被打散，張世傑手中已無成建制的舟師，朝廷只能退守臨安；而元軍的戰船與俘船正好補進了長江下游攻勢所需，一二七六年順流取臨安，一二七九年取崖山。焦山一役因此成為宋元戰爭中長江決戰的定盤星：火攻破鎖舟的做法在此後數百年的江海戰中不斷被重演。
resultEn: The Song arrayed across the river on the first of the month and the fighting began on the second. From morning into the afternoon the Yuan fire attack and the crossfire from the two wings came down together; the great Song ships burned, the chained line broke, the vanguard largely drowned and the rear broke and ran. Zhang Shijie, Liu Shiyong and Sun Huchen gathered what was left and withdrew; the Yuan pursued as far as Jiao Mountain and captured more than seven hundred vessels, among them the Huanghu and the Baiyao. The three-pronged plan had failed completely because Zhang Yan and Li Tingzhi never arrived, and the water fortress of Jiao Mountain and the command of the river passed to the Yuan. For the Yuan this was a complete demonstration of breaking a chained fleet with fire: fire arrows, crossbow bolts, the charge of light craft and the cavalry sealing the bank all worked at once, and the battle was over inside half a day without giving the Song time to reform. For the Song, the last usable barrier of water was shattered; Zhang Shijie had no formed fleet left, and the court could only fall back on Lin'an. The Yuan warships and captured hulls then went to fill the needs of the offensive on the lower Yangtze: Lin'an in 1276, Yamen in 1279. The battle of Jiao Mountain thus became the fixed point for the decisive river fighting of the Song-Yuan war, and the use of fire to break chained fleets was rehearsed again and again in the river and sea battles of the centuries that followed.
